description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gazette Ex. No. 1807/17 of 24.04.2013  - Cad Map No. 521001, Rathmalana D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing parcels of land in various locations (Kandawala, Attidiya South) with detailed descriptions of land blocks, cadastral maps, and amendments to land extent measurements.
